title: Pokemon TCG Pocket Cards V5 Gameplay No Image Schema
description: Sparse projection: a field is omitted when it does not apply. A null value is dropped, and Trainer cards keep only the fields the game exposes on them. A non-Fossil Trainer keeps identity, subtype, card text and deck number; a Fossil item additionally keeps stage, health, points and weakness. Pokemon records keep the full combat projection. Identical to the gameplay payload with the image URL dropped.

id.description: Set prefix and padded card number (e.g., "a1-001").

name.description: The printed name of the card.

subtype.description: Energy type for Pokémon. Item classification for Trainers.

stage.description: Basic, Stage 1, or Stage 2. Present on Pokémon and on fossil items; omitted on other Trainers.

evolves_from.description: The name of the required pre-evolution Pokémon. Present only on Stage 1 and Stage 2 cards.

special_tags.description: Tags like "ancient", "future", or "ultra_beasts". Present only when the card carries a tag.

health.description: The maximum hit points. Present on Pokémon and on fossil items; omitted on other Trainers.

retreat.description: The energy cost to retreat. Present on Pokémon; omitted on Trainers.

weakness.description: The energy type the Pokémon is weak to. Present on Pokémon that list a weakness and on fossil items, whose value is always "none"; omitted on other Trainers.

ability.description: Present on Pokémon; omitted on Trainers. Contains `exists` (boolean), `name` (string), and `effect` (string).

exists.description: True if the card has an ability.

name.description: The printed name of the ability.

effect.description: The mechanical effect text of the ability.

attacks.description: Present on Pokémon; omitted on Trainers. Contains keys `1` and `2`. Each holds `cost`, `name`, `damage` (integer), and `effect` (string).

card_text.description: The mechanical rules text. Present on Trainer cards; omitted on Pokémon.

points.description: Points awarded to the opponent when knocked out (1, 2, or 3). Present on Pokémon and on fossil items; omitted on other Trainers.

ex.description: True if the card is an "ex" rulebox Pokémon. Present only on Pokémon; Trainer cards omit it.

mega.description: True if the card is a Mega Evolution. Present only on Pokémon; Trainer cards omit it.

deckBuilderNr.description: The internal integer used by the game client for deck rendering.

attack.description: A single attack on a Pokémon card.

cost.description: The energy cost symbols required to use the attack.

name.description: The printed name of the attack.

damage.description: The base damage value of the attack.

effect.description: The additional effect text of the attack.
